name: Simulant Refuge Workshop
backstory: A military lead, a protected guard and a cautious civilian frame give the refuge a small adaptable roster. Their equipment roles are arena contracts rather than new source-world identities.
strategy_personality: Differentiate the collection through the film's exposed head mechanisms, lived-in clothing, and contrast between military and civilian equipment. Harun supplies a named identity; the other two require specific screen references before production. Keep the source's human-like features and avoid interchangeable metal soldiers. The three arena roles and their association are design proposals, rather than a claim that these exact individuals form a canonical team.

robots.name: Harun
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Harun from The Creator 2023, recognizable adult human-like face of the film character portrayed by Ken Watanabe, exposed cylindrical mechanical openings through the side/back of head and neck, source weathered light robes and layered scarf, restrained alert stance holding a source-style rifle low. Keep lived-in clothing and authentic simulant construction, no generic robot helmet.
Metadata only, do not render text: #173 slot 1 Harun.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Harun fills the measured mid-range fighter role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Tactician tuning supports the mid equipment role; balanced stance and a 15% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Generalist strategy tuning rules with the Tactician Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** The Creator — 2023 film  
**Strategy:** Generalist · **Target roster:** 3 robots

**Proposed robots:** Harun; Refuge Guard 02; Refuge Monk 03.

**Direction:** Differentiate the collection through the film's exposed head mechanisms, lived-in clothing, and contrast between military and civilian equipment. Harun supplies a named identity; the other two require specific screen references before production. Keep the source's human-like features and avoid interchangeable metal soldiers. The three arena roles and their association are design proposals, rather than a claim that these exact individuals form a canonical team.

References: [official production notes and character background](https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_creator_final_production_notes_bios_7962bbd8.pdf).

**Production edition:** The Creator 2023 film: Harun in source robe, adult military simulant and adult Buddhist monk simulant; latter names are original arena labels.  
**Catalogue key:** `simulant-refuge-workshop`
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–2; recruit slot 3 with its complete stage-0 loadout. Complete stage-1 loadouts in slot order. Refine the slot-1 lead only: verified Hone/Augment operations, then a first Sharpen at Workshop L5 and 3,000 prestige. Other slots have explicit empty refinement plans.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
